touches.text: Tool: a complete primitive. Has users, not an owner. Calls no other Cairn component (stdlib and base only) and owns no state of its own. Lives in cairn/tools/ (17). Its data for a holder lives under that holder: ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/tools/<tool>/.
Transient: things held for seconds to days (mail, logs, test runs, trouble tickets, inference tickets). The logging tree.

Cairn owns all of ~/.cairn/ and delegates each ~/.cairn/devices/ subtree to its device. Everything outside devices/ (~/.cairn/logging/ and the rest) is Cairn's, so every log is Cairn's and Cairn cleans them up in sleep. Transient things are files there; trouble tickets are logging items.
Holds the metrics table (17.27) until Recovery exists (6.6.3.4). Akien 2026-11-09: "the cairn device holds it until recovery exists".

Has its own email account (CC's, not Igor's; credentials under ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/, the only record). Its shim fetches the mail, since shims handle all interfacing with the outside world (5.8.3.8); CC never checks the mailbox itself.

The yield report (tokens spent against tokens saved, the meter for Telos 1) reads the metrics table (17.27): each call records its spent, saved and latency rows under the call as subject, kept forever, so the all-time total is a sum. Akien 2026-11-09, answering Q#78: "inference tickets are only for debugging, so we can't use that as a metric."

artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). WHY: errors are permanent in records of truth (Law 7), and the journal is what shows a record moved by hand. USERS: everyone who writes a record. [Q#91: The caller class is read from the kernel's cgroup path, so on Windows it reads null and the class comes only from env vars (CAIRN_USER, CLAUDECODE, CAIRN_OPERATOR); gate cannot be reached, and 3 teeth in test_artifact_door.py say UNRAN. Measured 2026-11-12: the Windows parent process chain does show claude.exe above a shell. Is Windows a first-class caller platform (an exe-name chain: claude.exe is cc, a console with no claude above it is akien, a service session is gate), or env-fallback only?]

metric: records a measurement of anything. WHY: a metric is a primitive; its job is to measure whatever it is, and like feedback (which a metric strictly is) it must eventually have a consumer. USERS: any probe or tool.
Each metric name is declared, with its consumer, in the charter of the component that records it. A name with no consumer is a red.

dataref: one address for any stored record, in any format, and the thin class that reads it. Shaped by Akien and CC 2026-11-09, grown from CC0AC-Weather 1.4.8's secrets.env. WHY: a config, a ticket or a node can say WHERE a value lives without carrying it, so the repo stays shareable and a private value stays in ~/.cairn; and one way of pointing works across every format and every box. USERS: anything that reads stored data.
